claims.statement: For a leaf-deletion forest H with marked set W meeting every component, the first-mark partition plus the cover-loss bound reduces q_(k+1)<=q_k to the displayed residual shadow or matching thresholds. In a shell n(T)=2p+s with s>=2, tau(T)>=ceil(3s/2)+1 supplies the residual matching-size thresholds; the pointwise conclusion additionally requires p-2>=K(d) on every residual block with d>=3. The Catalan cover-exclusion estimate fails to force the analogous parent threshold at s=5, terminal rank p-2.
claims.scope: Conditional marked-shell reduction and method cutoff only; it does not establish the cover hypothesis for every eligible tree, settle the s=4 p=10..13 low-cover cases, or prove/refute the registered global aggregate.
claims.reason: The marked partition and cover-loss steps are proved here, but the application remains conditional on a parent cover bound and inherited exact matching theorems. At s=5 the stated cover-Catalan bound is nonpositive at its terminal rank, leaving a genuine open shell obligation.

limitations: The report proves a conditional pointwise shell implication, not the parent cover threshold for all eligible trees.
The large-rank matching result is inherited and used only under its stated matching-size and rank hypotheses; no broader theorem is claimed.
The s=4 low-cover p=10..13 window remains unclassified by this reduction; no bounded census was run.
For s=5 the Catalan cover estimate has zero empty-fiber margin and a negative first nonempty-fiber floor at the terminal rank; this does not refute the shell target.
The registered lower-region favorable-leaf aggregate remains unresolved by this route.
